name: gaia
tagline_zh: Claude 原生全家桶，React 前端已铺好，你只管写后端。每次合并前有代码审查，提交前有门禁。
tagline_en: Claude-native foundation: React frontend done, you build backend. Pre-commit gates + code-review audit stop bad.
desc_en: The Claude-native foundation you build your whole app on. React frontend handled, your backend builds on top. Strict tooling, pre-commit gates, code-review audit before every merge.
why_zh: 同类里唯一把审查和门禁焊死在流程里，不是靠自觉，是机制逼你写干净代码。
why_en: Unlike others, review and gates are welded into the flow—not by willpower, but by mechanism forcing clean code.
